Field.name: Objective received
Field.Outcome: Component 1, the fulfillment recorder, is implemented and locally proven. Components 2 and 3 were not started.

Field.name: Knowledge preserved
Field.Preserved: The provider router, storefront chat and MCP paths, intake quiz, artwork rail, vision rail, OAuth controls, Shopify scopes, and all unrelated working-tree changes were preserved. No secret value was read, printed, copied, or committed.
Field.WorkingTreeNote: PKCE hardening and git-object-store evidence were already modified or untracked before this component began. The additive edits to package.json and schema.prisma preserve those in-progress changes.

Field.name: Wisdom applied and reasons

Change.reason: The fulfillment history is the dependency both later D-002 layers read.

Field.Change: Added one FulfillmentRecord model and one additive migration.

Change.reason: NR-8 and NR-9 require WHAT telemetry without WHO identity.

Field.Change: The database model and Prisma write allowlist contain product, routing, provider, variant, status, and timestamps only. Printify recipient data is never spread into or passed to persistence.

Change.reason: Printify Choice 99 is a routing option, not the concrete fulfiller.

Field.Change: The recorder reads line_items[].print_provider_id from the order response. If unresolved, it stores routing option 99 with a null selected provider, performs one immediate details lookup when an order id is available, and exposes an idempotent refreshOrder polling path for later status changes.

Change.reason: A successful order must not be forgotten or duplicated.

Field.Change: submitOrder persists only after a successful HTTP response, and Prisma upsert makes orderReference idempotent while allowing status/provider enrichment.

Field.name: Tests and exact outcomes
Field.Test: prisma format, validate, and generate completed successfully.

Against a disposable copy of prisma/dev.sqlite, migrate deploy applied the pending PKCE migration and the new fulfillment migration. A direct sqlite_master query confirmed FulfillmentRecord existed. The supplied rollback executed successfully, and a second query confirmed the table was absent. The disposable copy was deleted.

Against a second disposable migrated database copy, a pending Choice 99 event and its in-production redelivery produced one row, enriched printProviderIdSelected to 42, normalized status to in_production, and exposed no prohibited persistence field. The disposable copy was deleted.
Field.Observation: A separate attempt to replay the repository's full historical migration chain into a brand-new empty SQLite path ended in Prisma's generic "Schema engine error" before identifying or applying the new migration. The deployment-representative upgrade from a copy of the current database passed. No fresh-install claim is made from the failed replay.
Field.LiveTests: No live request, deployment, Printify order, or Shopify mutation was performed.

Field.name: Capability rung after work
Field.Component: Local implementation and deployment-representative migration upgrade are proven. Production is not claimed because no deployed real order has written a real FulfillmentRecord row.

Field.name: Unverified and live-only claims
Field.Claim: Component 1 deployment, live Printify Choice provider resolution, and a real Railway database write remain unverified.

The September 12 evidence closes OI-5 and OI-10 only for the project's operator-defined direct-endpoint gate. It explicitly states that the browser/widget UI, raw Shopify cart result, authenticated OAuth, completed checkout, database persistence, and exact Railway runtime SHA were not exercised. Therefore the directive's full browser round trip remains unverified and is not inherited as closed here.
Component 3 has created no product and has no live claim.

Still operator-owned and still gate Component 2 live meaning and SEO claims.

If a production proof is desired, authorize the normal deployment/release action and run one controlled real order through the new submission seam, then verify one telemetry-only row.
